meta.note: Habitat telemetry is simulated with planted faults. The detector is validated on real NASA SMAP/MSL spacecraft telemetry.

validation.dataset: NASA SMAP + MSL labeled telemetry anomalies (Hundman et al., KDD 2018)

meta.data_credit: Detector validation: NASA JPL SMAP & MSL telemetry anomaly dataset

ppco2_mmhg.label: Cabin CO₂
ppco2_mmhg.explain: Exhaled CO₂ builds up in a closed cabin and is removed by scrubbers. In space, crews report symptoms at lower levels than on Earth.
ppco2_mmhg.health_link: Headaches, poor sleep, fatigue and slower thinking are reported as CO₂ rises.

actions.amber: Check the scrubber status; increase airflow in crew quarters.
actions.red: Switch to backup CO₂ removal; notify flight surgeon of any headaches.

ppo2_kpa.label: Oxygen (partial pressure)
ppo2_kpa.explain: How much oxygen is available to breathe. Too little causes hypoxia; too much raises fire risk.
ppo2_kpa.health_link: Low oxygen causes fatigue, headache and poor judgement before you notice it.

actions.amber: Check the O₂ generator and sensors.
actions.red: Don emergency masks per procedure and contact ground.

cabin_pressure_kpa.label: Cabin pressure
cabin_pressure_kpa.explain: Total air pressure in the habitat. A slow drop usually means a leak.
cabin_pressure_kpa.health_link: A pressure drop reduces the oxygen you can absorb; a fast drop is an emergency.

actions.red: Isolate the affected module and move crew to the safe haven.

temp_c.label: Cabin temperature
temp_c.explain: Air temperature kept by the thermal control system.
temp_c.health_link: Heat stress worsens sleep, hydration and exercise tolerance.

actions.red: Reduce activity, hydrate, and contact ground.

rh_pct.label: Relative humidity
rh_pct.explain: Moisture in the air, removed by the condensing heat exchanger.
rh_pct.health_link: Very dry air irritates eyes and airways; very humid air encourages microbial growth.

actions.red: Contact ground; inspect for condensation and free water.
